title: Aurangzeb Expansion Of Empire
definition: The expansionist phase of the Mughal Empire under Aurangzeb (1658–1707) marked the territorial zenith of the empire, characterized by the annexation of the Deccan Sultanates and prolonged military engagement in the South.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Deccan Ulcer', the decline of the Mughal Empire, and the shift in administrative focus from North to South India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Aurangzeb Expansion Of Empire.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Deccan Policy of Akbar and Shah Jahan
